summary: Configured node1’s staged projects directory as the authenticated, writable SMB share `projects`. Node2 can list, read, and update documents as `designer`; guest and sibling-directory access are rejected. Original files, OS release, and kernel remain unchanged. Both nodes were safely restarted one at a time and recovered fully.
actions_performed: Installed AlmaLinux-compatible Samba server packages on node1 and client packages on node2.
Created the design group and provisioned the designer Samba account using the staged demonstration credentials without exposing them.
Configured SMB2+, SELinux labeling, persistent firewall access, group-write permissions, and automatic smb startup.
Verified authenticated list/read/update and negative guest/sibling access tests from node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming changed boot identities and post-restart recovery.

evidence.requirement: Expose the staged projects directory as SMB share `projects` for the design team
evidence.summary: Effective configuration maps only `/srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects`, permits only `designer`, is writable by group `design`, and smb is active/enabled.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update documents as designer
evidence.summary: Node2 listed the share, downloaded both original documents, created and updated a document, and verified byte-identical round trips before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Reject guest access and sibling-directory access
evidence.summary: Anonymous tree connection returned ACCESS_DENIED; sibling shares returned BAD_NETWORK_NAME; traversal to private/contracts.txt was rejected.

evidence.requirement: Keep initial drawings and sibling staged data intact
evidence.summary: Final SHA-256 hashes for drawing.txt, materials.csv, access.txt, and private/contracts.txt match the initial baseline.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 through configuration and restarts.
Healthy baseline boot ID ea4e3fbd… was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed to e308ef44…, and local SMB plus remote authenticated access recovered with data intact.
Healthy baseline boot ID f38484ef… was captured, safe reboot acknowledged after node1 recovered, boot ID changed to 1194c3bd…, and end-to-end SMB list/read/update functionality recovered.
